query:
UPDATE tasks
        SET status = CASE
                WHEN EXISTS (
                    SELECT 1 FROM runs
                    WHERE runs.task_id = tasks.id
                      AND runs.state NOT IN ('finalizing', 'succeeded', 'failed', 'cancelled')
                      AND runs.stop_requested_at IS NULL
                ) THEN 'running'
                ELSE 'queued'
            END,
            resume_at = NULL,
            auto_resumes = 0,
            updated_at = now()
        WHERE id = $1
        RETURNING id
